qualityChecks: All 198 visible stamp IDs and all 36 biome IDs accounted for.
Hidden legacy black-cat excluded from redesign.
Stable existing IDs preserved; calico-cat is the single newly approved ID.
Dancing cat has only two forelegs, with one raised paw. Rolling cat retained unchanged.
Final octopus and Kraken each show eight arms. Squid has eight shorter arms and two longer club-ended tentacles.
Final frog has no mushroom remnants. Natural coat markings and requested poses retained.
Packaged cells preserve visible silhouettes without neighboring major components.
Production sprite alpha is byte-identical to its PNG atlas.
Space and Underwater remain groundless and contain no baked sun/moon or decorative frame.

Unicorn source PNG and production WebP were composited over true black and pale lavender. Apparent white/checker patches in raw previews are hidden near-transparent RGB, not baked opaque backgrounds. No redraw required.
